name: East Lake Village Shopping Center
summary: East Lake Village Shopping Center is a convenient community shopping destination in Watsonville featuring 25 shops, restaurants, and services. Located at the junction of Highway 129 and Highway 152, the center offers both covered and uncovered patio areas for a comfortable shopping experience.
demographics: East Lake Village Shopping Center serves the Watsonville community and surrounding Pajaro Valley area, attracting primarily middle-income families and working-class households. The trade area reflects Watsonville's diverse population with a significant Hispanic demographic, along with agricultural workers and local residents seeking convenient neighborhood shopping. Visitors typically prioritize value-oriented shopping and essential services, with strong foot traffic from nearby residential neighborhoods and commuters traveling along Highway 129 and Highway 152.
description: East Lake Village Shopping Center is a well-established community shopping destination located at 936 East Lake Avenue in Watsonville, California. Strategically positioned at the intersection of Highway 129 and Highway 152, this accessible center serves as a convenient hub for residents of Watsonville and the greater Pajaro Valley region. The center features 25 diverse shops, restaurants, and service providers, offering a comprehensive mix of retail, dining, and essential services to meet the everyday needs of the local community. With its thoughtful design incorporating both covered and uncovered patios, East Lake Village provides visitors with a comfortable and pleasant shopping experience regardless of weather conditions. The center's convenient location and diverse tenant mix have made it a reliable neighborhood gathering place for families and individuals seeking quality shopping and dining options in the heart of Watsonville.
